og:
131 likes, 4 comments - publicdripbrand on June 19, 2026: "My handicap is embarrassing. My kids don’t care.

I’ll be real with you — I’m not the best golfer.

I know the game well enough to love it, poorly enough to keep it humble. My kid couldn’t care less what I shot. She just wants to know if she can ride in the cart.

That’s the thing about being a dad who golfs. The scorecard stops mattering pretty fast.

I started Public Drip because I wanted people to feel good in what they wear on the course - confident, comfortable, and completely themselves. No dress code anxiety, no feeling like you don’t belong. Just you, your game, and gear that actually fits the way you move through the world. Golf has always had a place for everyone. I just wanted to make sure it felt that way.

This Father’s Day, if you’re shopping for someone like that — or if you ARE someone like that — we’ve got you.

And if your game is as rough as mine: welcome. You’re among friends.

— Neil, Founder (Dad first, golfer second, and it shows)".

410 likes, 24 comments - publicdripbrand on May 15, 2026: "This is what a public space is supposed to look like. 🌿

Free summer camps with transportation and meals. Free golf every week for any kid under 18. A middle school golf league. Mentorship. Life skills. A real shot at a college scholarship.

That’s what Corica Park built — right here in Alameda, CA.

We started Public Drip because public spaces made us. The municipal gems, the open gates, the honor boxes — these places gave us community, self-expression, and a platform to be seen. Corica Park is exactly that for thousands of kids and the community in the East Bay. And right now, it’s all at risk.

The City of Alameda has spent over $2 million in taxpayer dollars on a lawsuit against Greenway Golf, the locally owned operator that created every single one of these programs. Trial starts May 18.

This isn’t about a golf course. It’s about who public spaces are actually for — and whether we let a small group of people take that away from the public athletes who need them most.

Swipe to see the full story. Then sign the petition. Link in bio.".

297 likes, 40 comments - publicdripbrand on April 16, 2026: "PUBLIC DRIP SS26 — OPEN SEASON

Available Friday, April 17th @11am EST at publicdrip.com

Introducing Public Drip’s SS26 Collection: Open Season, a collection built on the belief that the game is no longer confined. The fairway extends beyond the course, merging seamlessly with the rhythm of everyday life.

The 21-piece collection is grounded in a palette of earthy tones, emphasizing texture and versatility. Signature premium jacquard knit polos lead the offering, paired with nylon snapbacks and bucket hats, sand-toned double pleated pants, and new Anywhere Shorts available in black and olive engineered to move effortlessly across settings.

In addition to new seasonal styles, Public Drip is restocking select best-sellers from past collections. These proven staples return by demand, continuing to build a core wardrobe that defines the brand’s identity season after season.

Built for a wide spectrum of players, Open Season is worn by everyone—from weekend heroes to professionals competing at the highest level. It reflects a new era of the game, where performance and style are no longer separate, and access is no longer limited.

At its core, SS26: Open Season is about inclusivity and honoring the traditions of golf while continuing to opening it up to a broader audience.

Everything is in play. Everyone is invited.

📸: @greynot_gray | @thepartumco".
